description: Database schema for versioned agreements, deliveries, project messages, and scope changes. Extends existing briefs/proposals workflow with immutable agreement versions requiring both-party acceptance before production starts. All four new tables with constraints, indexes, RLS policies, and Supabase Storage bucket for private deliveries.
steps: Create database/migrations/002_delivery_workflow.sql with: (1) agreements table (id, brief_id, proposal_id, creator_id, brand_id, version INTEGER, deliverables JSONB, price, currency DEFAULT 'USD', milestones JSONB, included_revisions INTEGER, usage_requirements JSONB, creator_accepted_at, brand_accepted_at, created_at, updated_at). Add UNIQUE(proposal_id, version). Add GENERATED column both_accepted AS (creator_accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND brand_accepted_at IS NOT NULL) STORED. Add CHECK(version > 0).

Add deliveries table (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, agreement_id UUID REFERENCES agreements(id), creator_id UUID REFERENCES creator_profiles(id), version INTEGER, file_path TEXT NOT NULL, file_name TEXT NOT NULL, file_size_bytes BIGINT, mime_type TEXT, inspection_status TEXT CHECK IN ('pending','pass','fail','unsupported','error'), inspection_results JSONB, inspected_at TIMESTAMP, brand_approved_at TIMESTAMP, approval_notes TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()). Add UNIQUE(agreement_id, version). Add indexes on agreement_id, inspection_status.

Add project_messages table (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, agreement_id UUID REFERENCES agreements(id), sender_id UUID REFERENCES users(id), message_type TEXT CHECK IN ('comment','revision_request','scope_change_request'), content TEXT NOT NULL, delivery_version INTEGER, video_timestamp_seconds NUMERIC, proposed_changes JSONB, change_accepted_by_creator BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, change_accepted_by_brand BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()). Add indexes on agreement_id, sender_id, message_type.

Add scope_changes table (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, agreement_id UUID REFERENCES agreements(id), message_id UUID REFERENCES project_messages(id), previous_version INTEGER, new_version INTEGER, changes_summary TEXT, price_delta INTEGER, deadline_delta_days INTEGER, creator_accepted_at TIMESTAMP, brand_accepted_at TIMESTAMP, applied_at TIMESTAMP, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()). Add GENERATED column both_accepted AS (creator_accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND brand_accepted_at IS NOT NULL) STORED.

Add RLS policies for agreements: (1) Authenticated users can read agreements where they are creator_id's user OR brand_id's user. (2) Service role can insert. (3) Only participants can update their own acceptance timestamps. Follow pattern from database/rls-policies.sql.

Add RLS policies for deliveries: (1) Only creator can insert for their agreements. (2) Only participants (creator or brand) can read. (3) Only brand can update brand_approved_at. Use EXISTS subquery to check agreement participation.
Add RLS policies for project_messages: (1) Only participants can insert messages. (2) Only participants can read messages for agreement. (3) No updates/deletes (immutable message history).
Add RLS policies for scope_changes: Similar to agreements - only participants read, service role inserts, participants update their acceptance.

Create Supabase Storage bucket configuration in same migration: INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) VALUES ('deliveries', 'deliveries', FALSE) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Add storage policies: (1) Participants can read objects in deliveries bucket where path starts with their agreement_id. (2) Creator can insert to agreements/{agreement_id}/*. (3) No public access.
Add updated_at trigger for agreements table using existing update_updated_at_column() function.
acceptance_criteria: Migration file creates all 4 tables with correct columns, types, constraints, and indexes
UNIQUE constraints prevent duplicate agreement versions and delivery versions per agreement
CHECK constraints enforce valid inspection_status and message_type values
GENERATED columns both_accepted automatically compute when both timestamps exist
RLS policies enforce participant-only access - creator or brand can read their agreements/deliveries/messages, others cannot
Supabase Storage deliveries bucket created as private (public=false)
Storage policies allow creators to upload, participants to download, using path-based agreement_id filtering
verification: Run migration in Supabase SQL Editor: Copy contents of database/migrations/002_delivery_workflow.sql, paste in SQL Editor, execute, verify 'Success. No rows returned' message
Verify tables exist: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('agreements','deliveries','project_messages','scope_changes'). Expect 4 rows.

Verify RLS enabled: SELECT tablename, rowsecurity FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('agreements','deliveries','project_messages','scope_changes'). All should show rowsecurity=true.
Verify storage bucket: SELECT id, name, public FROM storage.buckets WHERE name='deliveries'. Expect 1 row with public=false.

Test constraint: Try INSERT INTO deliveries (agreement_id, creator_id, version, file_path, file_name, inspection_status) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), 1, '/test', 'test.mp4', 'invalid_status'). Expect error 'violates check constraint'.
findings:
Migration file 002_delivery_workflow.sql created with all required tables, constraints, indexes, RLS policies, and storage bucket configuration. Key implementation details:

1. Tables Created:
   - agreements: Versioned scope with UNIQUE(proposal_id, version), GENERATED both_accepted column, CHECK(version > 0)
   - deliveries: File metadata with UNIQUE(agreement_id, version), inspection_status CHECK constraint
   - project_messages: Comments and requests with message_type CHECK constraint, no update/delete policies (immutable)
   - scope_changes: Change tracking with GENERATED both_accepted column

2. RLS Policies:
   - All tables have participant-only access (creator OR brand can read their agreements/deliveries/messages)
   - Separate UPDATE policies allow each party to update their own acceptance timestamps
   - Service role inserts for agreements and scope_changes (via API)
   - Immutable messages (no UPDATE/DELETE policies)

3. Storage Configuration:
   - Private 'deliveries' bucket (public=FALSE)
   - Path-based access control using agreement_id in folder name
   - Creators can upload to agreements/{agreement_id}/*
   - Both participants can download from their agreement folders
   - UUID validation in storage policies using regex pattern

4. Triggers:
   - updated_at trigger added for agreements table

5. Build Verification:
   - npm run build: SUCCESS (0 errors, 2 pre-existing ESLint warnings unrelated to this change)

Next Steps (manual verification required):
   - Execute migration in Supabase SQL Editor
   - Verify tables exist with correct schema
   - Verify RLS enabled on all 4 tables
   - Verify storage bucket created as private
   - Test CHECK constraints with invalid data
